memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: When they left, they went into the hills and stayed there three days, until the pursuers had searched all along the road and returned without finding them. Then the two men started back. They came down out of the hills, forded the river and came to Joshua son of Nun and told him everything that had happened to them. They said to Joshua, "The Lord has surely given the whole land into our hands; all the people are melting in fear because of us." — Josh 2:22-24 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The spies escape safely, wait out the search, and return to Joshua with a report bursting with confidence: "The Lord has surely given the whole land into our hands." What a change from the last time spies were sent into this land! A generation earlier, ten spies had returned trembling, saying the people were too strong and the cities too great (Num 13:31-33). Their fear infected the whole nation and cost them forty years in the wilderness.

This time is different. These two men come back not with fear but with faith. And notice the source of their confidence: not their own strength, but what God is already doing — the people of the land "melting in fear." They saw God at work and gave Him the credit.

What made the difference? Faith looks at the same land, the same walls, the same enemies, and sees God's promise instead of the obstacles. The earlier spies saw giants; these saw God. Both reports were "accurate" about the difficulties, but only one was true to who God is.

We choose which report we will carry every day. Christ has already secured the victory over sin and death (1 Cor 15:57). We can walk in fear, staring at the walls, or we can walk in faith, trusting the God who has "surely given" us the victory in Him.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. When you face challenges, do you bring back a report of fear or of faith?
2. What "walls" are you focused on that God has already promised to bring down?
3. How does Christ's finished victory change the report you carry today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, give me eyes of faith like these spies. When I face towering obstacles, help me see Your promise and trust the victory You have already won in Christ. Amen.
